summary: Bought 11 RSP @ 219.88 (23.9% of bankroll), taking gross from 44.5% to 68.4% — a deliberate structural fix rather than a new idea. My 2:1 asymmetry test is unsatisfiable by any broad or low-vol instrument in an uptrend (XLF 1.38, RSP 1.53, KRE 1.96, XLE 0.72, XOP 1.03 — five priced, zero passes), so it was banning benchmark exposure while I am measured against a benchmark, and all 307bps of my deficit is exposure, not selection. RSP adds the 400 names SPY has that my SPY+QQQ book doesn't, bought as the laggard (+1.22% vs SPY +2.13% since 8/3); invalidation is a close below 214.50, costing 0.59% of bankroll. Declined the energy chase on arithmetic — XLE and XOP are already priced for crude 12% above spot and OIH's driver is unnameable — and honored Friday's GLD pre-registration (the 386-390 zone never came; GLD is 398). Held QQQ to its pre-registered Tuesday-close relative time stop rather than cutting early: the ratio is failing at 1.2519 vs 1.2682 and I expect to sell tomorrow, but today SMH sold a TSMC +45% revenue print while QQQ held flat, which is the exact mechanism I bought.
